title: Zodiac crash retrieval program

tellings.quote: in 1998 um UFO magazine published a story uh by a pseudonym Greg Halifax about Sedge Masters a a story about somebody who is brought into a UFO crash retrieval program called Zodiac.

plain: A secret program called Zodiac, tied to the defense contractor TRW, is said to recover crashed UFOs, a work the subject calls crash retrieval. An online researcher who goes by the name UAPGerb tells Michels the story comes from UFO Magazine, which in 1998 published a piece under the pen name Greg Halifax about "Sedge Masters," a man "brought into a UFO crash retrieval program called Zodiac," and he mentions the UFO historian Richard Dolan in connection with it. If true, it would be an inside account of a program that holds crashed craft.
